PACKET 16 - FIRST READING (unverified image reading)

EXPOSURE / PROCEDURE STATEMENT
- No proposed identification or prior reading of these leaves was present in my context. I did not search, consult any edition or catalogue, or read packet.json.
- Beyond the stated rules: I ran a directory listing (ls) of the packet directory only, to get the image filenames; and I kept draft notes in my own scratch directory while working, then concatenated them into this file. Nothing else was opened.
- All 42 images loaded. image-001 and image-022 are reduced overviews (face 1 and face 2). image-012, -017, -033, -038 show only the colour chart and backing cloth (plus a strip of leaf edge in 012/033, no text).
- The pieces carry modern pencil foliation numbers and pencil labels "Stams, STA, Fng. 98-5r ... 98-8v" (as written; I read these from the images, they are not an identification of the text).

LAYOUT SURVEY (observations)
- Each face shows four pieces of parchment on black cloth: three opened bifolia (two pages side by side) and one single page. Overview positions: top-left bifolium (pencil 15|12 on face 1, 13|14 on face 2), top-right bifolium (19|8 / 9|18), bottom-centre single page (6 / 7), bottom-right bifolium (17|10 / 11|16).
- Every page: two columns, ruled in drypoint/plummet, about 33-35 lines per column; text block occupies the upper ~60% of the page, the lower part ruled but blank. Writing ends at the same height on all pages, so the lower blank area looks original (unfinished or short pages) rather than cropped.
- One gothic textualis-type hand in brown ink, heavy abbreviation. Red: rubrics (feast headings beginning "In s(ancti)..." and section labels Introitus, Ozo/Oracio, Ep(isto)la/Lec(tio), Gr(aduale), All(elui)a V(ersus), tractus, Ev(angeliu)m, Offer(torium), Secreta, Com(munio), Comp(lenda)/Compl(enda)), red touched capitals on chant incipits, and two-line red initials (sometimes with flourished tails) at the start of each prayer.
- Content pattern (observation): short chant/reading incipits in run-on lines, with full prayers (collect / secret / postcommunion) written out. Saints' names recur in rubrics. No commentary, no glosses; a few marginal corrections and cancellations:
    * red "||" signs with inserted words in the margin (face 2: "ei(us)" beside 025.12; "uos" beside 030.04).
    * lines struck through with heavy red bars (face 1 page "8" col a 006.19-21; face 1 page "17" col b last line; face 2 page "18" col a first three lines; face 2 page "7" col a several words).
    * face 1 page "19" col b ends with a red rubric "Reliq(ua) uide i(n) fi(n)e libri et deinceps ..." with a red sign (circle over a cross) beside it.
    * face 2 page "9": faint traces of 2-3 lines below the end of both columns (erased text or offset; not read).
- No running titles visible.

WHAT WAS READ / NOT READ
- I transcribed essentially every text line on all 16 written columns of both faces. Line labels are "image.line" where the line number counts text lines from the top of that tile (approximate where a tile begins mid-line). Overlapping tiles repeat lines; each line is given once, from the clearest tile, and the column continuation switches to the next tile (e.g. 002.22 -> 007.06).
- Expansions in parentheses; "?" marks uncertain readings; red text marked [red]; decorated initials as [X red initial]. I have not supplied words from expectation; where an incipit was not clear I left it as seen.
- Not read: text under the red cancellation bars; the faint traces below page "9" (face 2).

LIMITATIONS
- Brown ink is smudged/abraded on face 1 page "17" and on parts of face 2 pages "11" and "16"; several abbreviation readings there are uncertain.
- Page "6"/"7" (single leaf) has a ragged outer edge but no text loss observed.
- Small notch/tear at the gutter foot of the 19|8 / 9|18 bifolium (below the text; no text loss). Crack at lower right of page "18".
- Order of pages within each bifolium is as mounted; I make no claim about original sequence.
